responsibility: Implements the analyzer’s experimental taint checker for attacker-controlled data. It defines an inheritable taint state machine with variants recording whether only lower or upper bounds have been checked, propagates taint through statements and conditions, diagnoses tainted control flow, array indices, offsets, sizes, divisors, and allocation extents, and adds region_model hooks that let other memory-model operations query or mark taint on svalues when checking accesses and dynamic object sizes.
